capabilities: Generate AI summaries and knowledge points
Build a daily review from a quiz bank
Chat with the current article and apply edits
disambiguation: Not a flowchart or knowledge-graph tool; it organizes clippings and builds study material from them.
extras: Free and requires no KnowFlow account; cloud model providers and DeepSeek Search are billed by their own APIs. Interface defaults to Simplified Chinese, and the fuller product background is written in Chinese. Automatic organize, summary and quiz generation are listed as not yet available and planned for 2.0.
problem: Clipped articles arrive with ads, broken headings and no study structure, so turning them into material to test and review takes manual work.

relations.evidence: DeepSeek Search can reuse a configured official API key, or use its own key.
Ollama and LM Studio connect to the local device by default.

summary: AI study assistant that cleans web clippings, generates summaries, knowledge points and quizzes, and runs a daily review from a quiz bank.
